title: Sesamin Suppresses Ovarian Cancer Progression via Modulation of Wnt/beta-Catenin and Associated Oncogenic Pathways.
authors: Maheswari Jayaveeran, Heera; Rajagopal, Ponnulakshmi; Parthiban, Manju; Jayaraman, Selvaraj; Varalakshmi V, Sureka; Chandrasekaran, Krithika
journal: Asian Pacific journal of cancer prevention : APJCP
one_liner_zh: 该文研究芝麻素对卵巢癌Wnt/β-catenin通路的抑制作用，仅涉及小分子-蛋白对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: OBJECTIVE: The current research aimed to explore the molecular pathway of sesamin in controlling the Wnt/beta-catenin signaling pathway and associated oncogenic regulators in ovarian cancer cells. METHODS: Molecular docking was conducted to assess sesamin's binding activity toward major signaling proteins (Wnt, beta-catenin, GSK3beta, TGF-beta). Functional confirmation was performed using quantitative PCR (qPCR) to quantify gene expression following a 48-hour treatment of ovarian cancer cells with sesamin. RESULT: Docking simulations revealed strong binding affinities, particularly with Wnt (-9.19 kcal/mol), supported by hydrogen bond interactions. qPCR results showed significant downregulation of Wnt (50%), TGF-beta (40%), GSK3beta (25%), and beta-catenin transcripts compared to the control (p < 0.001). CONCLUSION: Sesamin potently inhibits several oncogenic regulators within the Wnt/beta-catenin pathway, positioning it as a potential multi-target natural therapeutic for ovarian cancer. These findings support sesamin as a promising candidate for further preclinical and clinical investigation, particularly as an adjuvant therapy to overcome drug resistance and limit tumor progression.
abstract_zh: 目的：本研究旨在探讨芝麻素在卵巢癌细胞中调控Wnt/β-catenin信号通路及相关致癌调节因子的分子途径。方法：采用分子对接评估芝麻素与主要信号蛋白（Wnt、β-catenin、GSK3β、TGF-β）的结合活性。通过定量PCR（qPCR）对芝麻素处理卵巢癌细胞48小时后的基因表达进行功能验证。结果：对接模拟显示强结合亲和力，尤其是与Wnt（-9.19 kcal/mol）的结合，并由氢键相互作用支持。qPCR结果显示，与对照组相比，Wnt（50%）、TGF-β（40%）、GSK3β（25%）和β-catenin转录本显著下调（p < 0.001）。结论：芝麻素有效抑制Wnt/β-catenin通路中的多个致癌调节因子，使其成为卵巢癌潜在的多靶点天然治疗药物。这些发现支持芝麻素作为进一步临床前和临床研究的有前景候选药物，特别是作为克服耐药性和限制肿瘤进展的辅助治疗手段。
